# Neural Architect / DLSS 5 Checker

Neural Architect is an independent, free DLSS 5 GPU compatibility checker. It explains what is confirmed by NVIDIA, what remains unconfirmed, and how DLSS 5 relates to DLSS 4 and FSR 4. It is not affiliated with NVIDIA.

## Primary pages
- English checker: https://www.dlss5.app/en
- 简体中文检测器: https://www.dlss5.app/zh-CN
- Traditional Chinese checker: https://www.dlss5.app/zh-TW
- English technical guides: https://www.dlss5.app/en/blog
- Chinese technical guides: https://www.dlss5.app/zh-CN/blog
- Official NVIDIA DLSS information: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/technologies/dlss/
- Free visual conversion tool: https://dlss5nvidia.com

## Data policy
- RTX 50 / Blackwell DLSS 5 support is marked confirmed when backed by official NVIDIA material.
- RTX 40 support is shown as unconfirmed unless NVIDIA publishes a compatible list.
- RTX 30 and RTX 20 are described against the current official compatibility information; the checker does not infer support from community claims.
- Last content review: 2026-10-10.
